upstreamReview.runtimeDecision: the alpha branch targets only the source-built 0.1.2-alpha.1 runtime; isolated 3091 composition/Web/Workspace/Session/Aezy-plugin and mode/preset gates pass, while full parity gates still block merging the branch to main
upstreamReview.ownershipImpact: alpha.1 moves shipped Agent presets into the preset package with includeShippedRoot, renames code mode to ptc, adds durable preset/tool-change and model-selection projections, replaces ApiProxy with Remote gateway/controllers, splits the client runtime, adds Models provider-card slots, exact per-turn usage, configurable subagent models, experimental Agent Teams, packed Session transport, Web auth, SSRF-safe public WebFetch, and terminal/process fixes. Aezy now consumes the shipped standard preset as authority, adds only an external codex-app-server overlay, filters the Host-wide catalog in the current Session UI, and enforces the provider at preset and adapter execution boundaries. The remaining adoption gap is full M0-M4.2/Terminal/Security/Codex/self-development parity, not another Session, tool, preset, or agent-loop kernel.

releaseAvailability.runtimeBlockedReason: The official npm registry still has no @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.1. The isolated alpha composition and mode/preset gates are complete, but the full M0-M4.2/Terminal/Security/Codex/self-development parity gates are not complete.
